notes.title: We need some help
notes.content:
Hi people!
As title says we need some help.
What is it about?
We understand that we need to rework the game. We have some ideas about it, but we don't really understand are there changes need to be done.
There some of it:
Change model of a mian person
Add some difficulties like secure turrets and moving walls
Add minimap with marks to make game a little bit easier

Tell us what to do
